column7: Lends a direct route's resolved headers together with the check that guards their every send; a mistake would lend a credential no send rechecks
Gives a caller's forwarded bearer a check scoped to its own dispatch, judged only by its own JWT exp; a mistake would send it with no check or evict a slot on it
Reads a JWT's exp without verifying it, only from a three-segment token whose header names an alg; a mistake would misread an opaque token or let an unverified claim extend a lifetime

Decides each send of a non-managed credential: a published expiry past refuses definitively, a past JWT exp or synthetic expiry refuses this loan, an unreadable clock is transient; a mistake would send an expired credential or evict on a routine refresh
Rechecks a managed account's grant through its custody before each send; a mistake would send a revoked grant
Maps a custody refusal to definitive or transient; a mistake would keep a revoked grant's slot or evict on a busy custody
On a lent-only slot merges only the call's Mcp-Param mirrors, never the caller's copy of the credential; a mistake would put a credential other than the checked loan's on the wire
Picks and checks a lent-only send's loan through the slot's lender, refusing a slot with none; a mistake would send unchecked or as another call's loan
Sends a handshake request with the call's own headers so a lent-only slot sends as that call's loan; a mistake would send the handshake as nobody or as another call
Runs a slot's handshake inside a call with that call's headers; a mistake would start a lent-only slot as nobody or as another call

Gives a slot start's own sends the call that resolves, at each send, to the oldest dispatch still waiting on the start; a mistake would send a start as nobody, as an ended dispatch, or let another send borrow the start's loan
Opens a legacy SSE stream as the call's credential, so a session-expiry re-handshake sends as the call that met it; a mistake would open it as nobody or as another call
The direct route's terminal arm body, boxed by dispatch: forwards and answers, settling the reservation on failure; a mistake would answer without a send or keep a failed reservation
